capabilities.summary: Spend reservation, allowance and compare-and-swap ledger on SQLite: integer micro-units, idempotent reserve on request id, in-flight and overrun handling, opaque allowance periods, optional account key and per-reservation currency, billed-unknown commit, caller-transaction (`_in`) variants, strict transition mode
policyNotes: Declaration-only: the ledger tables and reservation state machine are not an ownership fingerprint.
Price rows live in rightkit-llm; the ledger stores opaque route and price-version text; an allowance holds no currency and a reservation holds only the currency text the caller passes.
